name: Heijmans / Avular autonomous electric asphalt roller
summary: Battery-electric asphalt roller made driverless by the Dutch robotics firm Avular for the contractor Heijmans. It follows pre-programmed instructions, watches asphalt temperature and compaction and adjusts itself, while an operator supervises remotely.

germany.statusNote: Prototype used by the Dutch contractor Heijmans, not offered for sale. Avular (Eindhoven) offers to add autonomy to customers' construction machines on request, but this roller is not a catalogue product.

specs.label: Drive
specs.quote: The roller runs on batteries, producing no exhaust fumes and less noise than diesel-powered equipment.

specs.label: Control
specs.value: pre-programmed autonomous operation with real-time adjustment, remote operator supervision
specs.quote: The roller continuously monitors asphalt temperature and compaction levels, making adjustments as needed under remote operator supervision.

specs.label: Safety
specs.quote: The machine is also fitted with an emergency braking system to bolster safety claims.

specs.label: Autonomy partner
specs.value: Avular adds autonomy to an existing machine
specs.conditions: base roller make and model not named
specs.quote: By integrating autonomous capabilities into existing vehicles, Avular transforms traditional construction equipment into intelligent, automated solutions

notes: Roller drums counted as wheels; size, weight and base machine not stated.
Long-term aim: one operator coordinating several machines; Heijmans is also looking at automating pavers (press).

images.alt: Heijmans autonomous asphalt roller on site

evidence.task: First public live demonstration of the driverless roller compacting asphalt
evidence.note: Attended by Schiphol, Heijmans, Avular and Dutch media (NOS, BNR).

evidence.task: Production model planned to join Heijmans asphalt crews
evidence.note: Plan stated in October 2025, if trials succeed; current status not checked.

sources.title: Heijmans unveils Europe's first self-driving electric road roller (3 October 2025)
Autonomous asphalt roller debuts at Schiphol

openQuestions: Which roller make and model is the base machine, and its weight and drum width?
